name: Hyundai Autoever Corporation
summary: Hyundai Autoever Corporation provides information and communication technology services in South Korea and internationally. The company offers vehicle IT services, such as mobility SW and SW development environment platforms, edge cloud computing, digital cockpit, and high definition map. It also provides DT services, including intelligent factory, mobility as a service, and enterprise IT solutions. In addition, it offers various core technologies consisting of cloud, big data, artificial intelligence, and cyber and vehicle securities.
